Come subscribe to join the adventure!

snippet.title: What If
snippet.description:
An epic exploration of possibilities. Join Peter and explore science-based hypothetical worlds across space, technology, Earth, and prehistoric history. Each episode begins with a simple “what if” question and follows real scientific theory, physics, biology, and astronomy to see where those ideas could lead.

Travel from deep space and alien planets to future technology and ancient life on Earth, and discover how small changes in science or history could reshape life, civilization, and the universe. It’s a blend of science education, imagination, and real research that helps you see our world, and the cosmos, from a fresh perspective.

snippet.title: Silence of the Earth
snippet.description:
Welcome to Silence of the Earth.

This channel is your dedicated refuge for relaxing documentary content, meticulously crafted to guide you toward deep, restful sleep. We specialize in atmospheric journeys into Deep Time, exploring the most tranquil and least-known corners of Prehistoric Earth.

Forget the noise. Our mission is to calm the anxious mind with sleep-friendly narratives. We unveil the silent history of our planet—from the earliest origins of life and the mysteries of forgotten ages to the immense silence of the cosmos.

This is more than a documentary; it is an immersive, atmospheric voyage designed for insomnia relief and ultimate peace.

Subscribe and let the silence take hold.
